notes: Sourced primarily from the official disguise "GX 3+ Hardware Guide" (Q3 2025 PDF, help.disguise.one), which includes a fully labeled rear-panel diagram — used to confirm every port name/count/connector and the explicit HDMI 2.0, DisplayPort 1.4, 10GBit/s and 100GBit/s labels. Cross-checked against the disguise.one GX 3+ product page and the GX 3 (non-plus) spec sheet, since GX 3+ shares the same 4U chassis/rear layout — the 4U rack height and the 5x-USB-3.0 total (2 front + 3 rear) were confirmed via the base GX 3 spec sheet, as the GX3+-specific guide's rear panel matches port-for-port but doesn't restate chassis dimensions. The GX 3+ upgrades networking vs base GX 3 (4x 10GbE instead of 1x1GbE+2x10GbE) per both the diagram and product page. Video I/O is modular: VFC (Video Format Conversion) card bays default to 3x HDMI 2.0 outputs but can be swapped for DisplayPort, Quad-DVI, Quad-SDI, or IP/ST2110 (ST 2110 support "not available at launch" per VFC card notes) — the 3 HDMI ports listed reflect as-shipped default only. The 12x HD-BNC (mini-BNC) video-input bank is dual-mode: 12 independent 3G-SDI inputs or 3 groups of 4 forming quad-link 12G-SDI; grade sdi-3g was used per physical connector (its native per-cable capacity) with a note on the 12G option. Peak power consumption for the + variant (with its NVIDIA Blackwell GPU) was not confirmed in available documents (base GX 3 lists 700W peak, but GX 3+ likely differs). QSFP28 100GbE ports were mapped to the closest available connector id "sfp" (not an exact form-factor match) and left ungraded since no eth-100g value exists in the provided grade scale.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Neutrik powerCON TRUE1 inlet, 100–240V 50/60Hz. Closest available connector id; the actual part is specifically powerCON TRUE1 (lockable/live-mating variant), not generic powerCON.

ports.name: HDMI Out (VFC 1)
ports.note: Default VFC (Video Format Conversion) card slot; ships standard with HDMI 2.0. Slot also accepts DP 1.2/1.4, Quad-DVI, Quad-SDI, or IP/ST2110 VFC cards, which change the physical connector/grade.

ports.name: HDMI Out (VFC 2)
ports.note: Same VFC slot notes as VFC 1.

ports.name: HDMI Out (VFC 3)
ports.note: Same VFC slot notes as VFC 1. One of these outputs is typically used as the extra/control GUI output.

ports.name: DisplayPort 1.4 (GUI)
ports.note: Dedicated GUI/control-monitor output, fixed (not a VFC card slot).

ports.name: 100GbE E
ports.note: Physical connector is QSFP28, not standard SFP — 'sfp' used as the closest available id. Grade omitted: port is 100Gb/s, which exceeds the eth- grade scale provided (max eth-25g), and fiber/pluggable connectors are excluded from grading per instructions.

ports.name: 100GbE F
ports.note: Same QSFP28/grade caveat as 100GbE E.

ports.name: Management Port (MGMT)
ports.note: Dedicated system-management Ethernet port; speed not stated in source documents, so grade omitted.

ports.name: SDI In A
ports.note: HD-BNC (mini-BNC) connector, requires 75-ohm HD-BNC cable or adapter to standard BNC. Bank of 12 (A–L) is configurable as 12x independent 3G-SDI (grade shown, native per-cable rating) or grouped in 4s as 3x quad-link 12G-SDI.

ports.name: SDI In B
ports.note: Same bank/quad-link notes as SDI In A.

ports.note: Same bank/quad-link notes as SDI In A.
